Watts made this hymn from Psalm 124, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare— 2if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us, 3when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive, 4then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us, … 4 more verses PSALM 124 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 124
Had not the Lord, may Israel say, Had not the Lord maintain'd our side, When men to make our lives a prey, Rose like the swelling of the tide; STANZA I
Watts's psalms run from Psalm 1 to Psalm 150, several settings to many psalms: 367 hymns. This is number 124. Point at a tick to see the hymn; click it to open that hymn.
